justification: Didn't change much, and didn't need to. Omarion had a quiet one last week carrying a short workload, but he showed up and did his job, so he's getting his one more week to respond before anybody starts second-guessing him. Corum's rolling — scored again last week on belief, not just the sheet, and a kid playing like that keeps the job. Mark had a tough bounce with that fumble, but one play doesn't erase a season of showing up, so he gets his week too. Puka and Terry earned their spots with how they played, plain and simple. The one real change: Amon-Ra's got no game this week, and I'm not starting a man who can't take the field over one who can, so Wan'Dale steps in — that's not a character call, that's just common sense. McPherson and the Chargers D are the only men we've got at those spots, bye or no bye, best we've got takes the field. Clear eyes, full hearts.
